versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No feature or logic changes; only documentation cleanup.
- Functionality and workflow remain unchanged.

v1.1: security hardening based on ClawHub audit (9 findings). No features removed, only added safety guards, user confirmations, and data redaction. Frontmatter restricts invocation scope; Step 1.2 verifies process ownership before kill; preflight mode is now strictly read-only (GET-only); Step 2.1.6 redacts Authorization/Cookie/password in diagnostics; Step 2.3 adds safety notice and new db_verify config; reports exclude raw bodies/tokens/credentials; Notes corrected. README updated with safety notes section.

Initial release with automated iterative project polishing and verification.

- Automates project start, verification (backend, frontend, API, DB), scoring, and fixes in a loop until perfect.
- Supports browser-based frontend testing, API endpoint detection, and database state checks.
- Offers configurable modes (full/preflight), scope, auto-fix strategies, and reporting output.
- Automatically manages Git branches, process cleanup, and common dependency/startup issues.
- Produces detailed markdown/HTML reports of all verification and polishing rounds.
